en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large Gothic and Gothic‑revival cathedral complex with twin ornate spires rising from a fortified hilltop ensemble of long, steep‑roofed buildings. The complex stands above a slope planted with what appear to be vineyards, and is surrounded by trees and smaller historic buildings. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.
